payload.title: SM120 RMSNorm-MLP NVFP4 Fusion and PDL Handoff Report
payload.summary: This report summarizes the reusable findings from SM120 RMSNorm, NVFP4 input quantization, parent MLP, and Programmatic Dependent Launch experiments. It is written as an English knowledge report and omits project task numbering.

sections.heading: Programmatic Dependent Launch Facts
sections.gist: CUDA 13 headers expose the relevant device-side APIs on the local SM120 stack:

sections.heading: Route Summary
sections.gist: table columns: Route, Correctness, Performance outcome, Decision

sections.heading: No-PDL Boundary Fusion
sections.gist: The no-PDL route fuses residual/RMSNorm and input NVFP4 quantization before the parent MLP path.

sections.heading: Whole-A PDL Handoff
sections.gist: Whole-A PDL releases the dependent C1 launch only after the full A payload and scale have been produced.

sections.heading: Row-Chunk PDL Pipeline
sections.gist: Row-chunk PDL tries to overlap quantization for one row chunk with C1/C2 work for another chunk.

sections.heading: C1 Wait-Cache
sections.gist: The row-ready C1 route publishes per-row or per-chunk readiness and makes C1 wait before loading A/input scale.

sections.heading: Practical Boundary
sections.gist: Do not promote these PDL routes without a non-negative operator gate on clean repeated runs.
